findings.finding: The validation_report.json references reviewed_commit 0feace24 (pre-merge worktree commit) rather than the merge commit 8c18865. This is expected — the run was performed on the author's worktree before merge. The merge commit correctly contains all deliverables.

The table_label_percent field only captures the first percentage column in multi-column tables (e.g., 4-column revenue table). This is a known limitation documented in the README and filed as a defect record with resolution=accepted_limitation.
The market_reference field requires a parenthesised publication year, so 2 of 5 references on the source page were dropped. This is a known limitation documented and filed as a defect record.

OCR-based ground truth comparison is structurally unavailable: no labelled corpus exists for this document type. This is outside the m22060 frozen acceptance criteria and is the known root cause of overall_status=partial. Moved from checks_not_run to findings/limits per contract.
